name: Six Senses La Sagesse
insider_take: This eco-luxury sanctuary sits on Grenada's pristine southeast coast, where untouched rainforest meets La Sagesse Bay's protected marine reserve.
whats_special: Six Senses La Sagesse occupies one of the Caribbean's most biodiverse locations, featuring three secluded beaches including the famous La Sagesse Beach. The property is built around sustainable luxury principles, with solar power, rainwater harvesting, and a zero-waste philosophy. Guests can spot leatherback turtles nesting seasonally right on the resort's doorstep, while the adjacent Nature Centre protects 19 acres of mangrove wetlands teeming with tropical birds and marine life.
pro_tip: Visit during turtle nesting season (March-August) for guided nighttime turtle watching experiences, and book the signature spa treatment using locally-sourced nutmeg and cocoa - Grenada is the world's second-largest nutmeg producer.
dont_miss: The resort's organic garden-to-table dining program showcases Grenada's "Spice Island" heritage, while the nearby Telescope Beach offers some of the Caribbean's best snorkeling in crystal-clear waters. Take the resort's complimentary kayaks to explore the mangrove channels, or hike the coastal trail to discover hidden coves accessible only on foot.
